claims.statement: The third article says Olokun embodies the sea in its terrifying (aterrador) aspect, alien to humans, and all the riches of the ocean (riquezas del océano) are his.
claims.statement_id: Artikel ketiga menyebut Olokun mewujudkan laut dalam aspeknya yang menakutkan (aterrador) dan asing bagi manusia, dan semua kekayaan samudra (riquezas del océano) adalah miliknya.
claims.quote: Encarna al mar en su aspecto aterrador y extraño al hombre, y todas las riquezas del océano son suyas.

claims.statement: According to the third article, Obbatalá chained (encadenó) him to the bottom of the ocean when he tried to kill humanity with the flood (diluvio).
claims.statement_id: Menurut artikel ketiga, Obbatalá merantainya (encadenó) di dasar samudra ketika ia mencoba membinasakan manusia dengan air bah (diluvio).
claims.quote: Obbatalá lo encadenó al fondo del océano, cuando intentó matar a la humanidad con el diluvio.

claims.statement: He is sometimes represented as half man, half fish (mitad hombre, mitad pez), though this is not fixed.
claims.statement_id: Kadang ia digambarkan setengah manusia, setengah ikan (mitad hombre, mitad pez), walaupun hal ini tidak tetap.
claims.quote: En ocasiones se le representa mitad hombre, mitad pez, aunque esto es indefinido

claims.statement: Abiku refers to the spirit of a child who dies young.
claims.statement_id: Abiku merujuk pada roh anak yang mati muda (spirit of a child who dies young).
claims.quote: refers to the spirit of a child who dies young

claims.statement: The belief holds that the spirit can return to the same mother many times, producing several short-lived children, or move to other mothers.
claims.statement_id: Menurut kepercayaan, roh itu dapat kembali ke ibu yang sama berkali-kali sehingga lahir beberapa anak yang berumur pendek, atau pindah ke ibu lain.
claims.quote: the belief is that the spirit can return to the same mother multiple times, resulting in multiple short-lived children, or transfer to other mothers.

claims.statement: When not residing in a person, the spirits are believed to live in trees, especially iroko, baobab and silk-cotton.
claims.statement_id: Saat tidak menghuni manusia, roh-roh ini dipercaya tinggal di pohon, terutama iroko, baobab, dan kapuk (silk-cotton).
claims.quote: When not residing in a person, the spirits are believed to live in trees, especially the iroko, baobab and silk-cotton species.

claims.statement: They are seen as dangerous, capable of murder, and especially likely to target children on their thirteenth birthday.
claims.statement_id: Mereka dipandang berbahaya, mampu membunuh, dan terutama menyasar anak pada ulang tahun ketiga belas.
claims.quote: They are seen as dangerous, capable of murder, and especially likely to target children on their thirteenth birthday.

claims.statement: From the viewpoint of contemporary biomedicine, the Abiku phenomenon may have been a way of understanding sickle cell carrying.
claims.statement_id: Dari sudut pandang biomedis kontemporer, fenomena Abiku mungkin merupakan cara memahami pembawa sifat sel sabit (sickle cell).
claims.quote: Seen through the lens of contemporary biomedicine, the Abiku phenomenon could have been a way of understanding sickle cell carrying.

claims.statement: Ben Okri's novel The Famished Road is based upon an abiku.
claims.statement_id: Novel Ben Okri, The Famished Road, berlandaskan pada abiku.
claims.quote: Ben Okri's novel The Famished Road is based upon an abiku.

claims.statement: A child who dies before twelve years of age is called an Abiku, and the spirit or spirits that caused the death are also called Abiku.
claims.statement_id: Anak yang mati sebelum berusia dua belas tahun disebut Abiku, dan roh yang menyebabkan kematiannya juga disebut Abiku.
claims.quote: a child who dies before twelve years of age being called an Abiku, and the spirit, or spirits, who caused the death being also called Abiku.

claims.statement: Uninhabited country is thought to be full of evil spirits or demons who suffer hunger, thirst and cold because nobody sacrifices to them and they have no temples.
claims.statement_id: Daerah tak berpenghuni dipercaya penuh roh jahat atau demon (evil spirits or demons) yang menderita lapar, haus, dan dingin karena tak ada yang memberi mereka sesaji dan mereka tak punya kuil.
claims.quote: uninhabited tracts of country abound with numbers of evil spirits or demons, who suffer from hunger, thirst, and cold, since nobody offers sacrifice to them and they have no temples

claims.statement: Once an Abiku has entered a child, it takes most of the child's food for itself and its companions.
claims.statement_id: Setelah masuk ke tubuh anak, Abiku mengambil sebagian besar makanan anak itu untuk dirinya dan kawan-kawannya.
claims.quote: When an Abiku has entered a child he takes for his own use, and for the use of his companions, the greater part of the food that the child eats

claims.statement: The mother fastens iron rings and small bells to the child's ankles and hangs iron chains around its neck.
claims.statement_id: Sang ibu memasang cincin besi dan lonceng kecil di pergelangan kaki anak serta menggantungkan rantai besi di lehernya.
claims.quote: she attaches iron rings and small bells to the ankles of the child, and hangs iron chains round his neck.

claims.statement: The jingling of iron and tinkling of bells is supposed to keep the Abikus away.
claims.statement_id: Gemerincing besi dan bunyi lonceng dipercaya menjauhkan para Abiku.
claims.quote: The jingling of the iron and the tinkling of the bells is supposed to keep the Abikus at a distance

claims.statement: Often the child's corpse is simply thrown into the bush to punish the Abiku.
claims.statement_id: Jenazah anak sering dibuang begitu saja ke semak (bush) untuk menghukum Abiku.
claims.quote: Often the corpse is simply thrown into the bush, to punish the Abiku, say the natives.

claims.statement: The term abiku applies both to certain spirits that can possess children and to the children inhabited by these spirits.
claims.statement_id: Istilah abiku dipakai untuk roh tertentu yang dapat merasuki anak (posséder les enfants) sekaligus untuk anak yang dihuni roh itu.
claims.quote: Le terme abiku est appliqué à la fois à certains esprits qui peuvent venir posséder les enfants, et également aux enfants qui sont habités par ces esprits.

claims.statement: When several children of a family die in turn, it is said to be the same child leaving and returning.
claims.statement_id: Bila beberapa anak dalam satu keluarga meninggal berturut-turut, dikatakan bahwa anak yang sama pergi dan kembali (même enfant qui part et qui revient).
claims.quote: on dit alors que c'est le même enfant qui part et qui revient

claims.statement: An Abiku is a changeling (Wechselbalg) that comes from the spirit world (Geisterwelt) and is born as a human.
claims.statement_id: Abiku adalah anak tukaran (Wechselbalg) yang berasal dari dunia roh (Geisterwelt) dan lahir sebagai manusia.
claims.quote: Ein Abiku ist ein Wechselbalg, das der Geisterwelt entstammt und als Mensch geboren wird.

claims.statement: Abiku are known from the tales of the Yoruba people (Yoruba-Volk), who live mainly in Nigeria in West Africa (Westafrika).
claims.statement_id: Abiku dikenal dari kisah-kisah bangsa Yoruba (Yoruba-Volk) yang terutama bermukim di Nigeria, Afrika Barat (Westafrika).
claims.quote: Abiku sind aus den Erzählungen des vor allem in Nigeria ansässigen Yoruba-Volks in Westafrika bekannt.

claims.statement: Damballa is one of the most important loa (spirits) in West African Vodun, Haitian Voodoo and other African diaspora traditions such as Obeah.
claims.statement_id: Damballa adalah salah satu loa (roh) terpenting dalam Vodun Afrika Barat, Voodoo Haiti, dan tradisi diaspora Afrika lain seperti Obeah.
claims.quote: is one of the most important of all loa, spirits in West African Vodun, Haitian Voodoo and other African diaspora religious traditions such as Obeah.

claims.statement: He is traditionally portrayed as a great white or black serpent.
claims.statement_id: Ia secara tradisional digambarkan sebagai ular besar berwarna putih atau hitam (serpent).
claims.quote: He is traditionally portrayed as a great white or black serpent

claims.statement: Damballa originated in the city of Wedo (Whydah or Ouidah) in modern-day Benin.
claims.statement_id: Damballa berasal dari kota Wedo (Whydah atau Ouidah) di wilayah Benin modern.
claims.quote: Damballa originated in the city of Wedo (Whydah or Ouidah) in modern-day Benin.

claims.statement: Damballa is said to be the sky father and primordial creator of all life, or the first thing created by the Bondye.
claims.statement_id: Damballa disebut sebagai bapa langit dan pencipta purba segala kehidupan, atau ciptaan pertama Bondye.
claims.quote: Damballa is said to be the sky father and the primordial creator of all life, or the first thing created by the Bondye.

claims.statement: In Vodou societies that see him as primordial creator, he made the cosmos with his 7000 coils, forming the stars and planets and shaping the hills and valleys of Earth.
claims.statement_id: Dalam komunitas Vodou yang memandangnya sebagai pencipta purba, ia menciptakan kosmos dengan 7000 lilitannya: membentuk bintang dan planet serta bukit dan lembah di bumi.
claims.quote: In those Vodou societies that view Damballa as the primordial creator, he created the cosmos by using his 7000 coils to form the stars and the planets in the heavens and to shape the hills and valleys on Earth.

claims.statement: By shedding his serpent skin, Damballa created all the waters on Earth.
claims.statement_id: Dengan berganti kulit ular, Damballa menciptakan semua perairan di bumi.
claims.quote: By shedding the serpent skin, Damballa created all the waters on the Earth.

claims.statement: Damballa is seen as benevolent, patient, wise and kind, yet detached from the trials of daily human life.
claims.statement_id: Damballa dipandang baik hati (benevolent), sabar, bijak, dan ramah, tetapi berjarak dari urusan sehari-hari manusia.
claims.quote: Damballa is seen as benevolent and patient, wise and kind, yet detached and removed from the trials and tribulations of daily human life.

claims.statement: As a serpent and because of his great wisdom, he does not speak but may whistle or hiss softly.
claims.statement_id: Sebagai ular dan karena kebijaksanaannya yang luar biasa, ia tidak berbicara, tetapi dapat bersiul atau mendesis pelan.
claims.quote: As a serpent, and due to his extreme wisdom, he does not speak, but may whistle or make a soft, hissing sound.

claims.statement: In some Vodou societies she is his sister, and in others Damballa himself in a different form.
claims.statement_id: Di sebagian komunitas Vodou, Ayida Wedo dianggap saudarinya (sister), dan di komunitas lain dianggap Damballa sendiri dalam rupa lain.
claims.quote: although in some Vodou societies, she is his sister and in others, Damballa himself after a different fashion.

claims.statement: A serviteur believed to be possessed by Damballa in a ceremony moves on the floor like a serpent.
claims.statement_id: Pemuja (serviteur) yang dipercaya dirasuki Damballa dalam upacara bergerak di lantai seperti ular.
claims.quote: When a serviteur is believed to be possessed by Damballa during a ceremony, he or she moves on the floor like a serpent.

claims.statement: Offerings to him include milk, white foods and flowers, rice, coconut, orgeat syrup and a perfume called lotion pompeia.
claims.statement_id: Persembahan untuknya meliputi susu, makanan dan bunga putih, nasi, kelapa, sirup orgeat, dan parfum lotion pompeia.
claims.quote: Offerings to him include milk, white foods and flowers, rice, coconut, orgeat syrup, and a perfume called lotion pompeia.

claims.statement: Damballa is usually syncretized with Saint Patrick or Moses.
claims.statement_id: Damballa biasanya disinkretiskan dengan Santo Patrick atau Musa (Moses).
claims.quote: Damballa is usually syncretized with either Saint Patrick or Moses.

claims.statement: Damballah (also Damballa, Danbala, Dam Ballah) is the serpent-shaped highest loa (schlangenförmige oberste Loa) in the Haitian religion of Voodoo.
claims.statement_id: Damballah (juga Damballa, Danbala, Dam Ballah) adalah loa tertinggi berwujud ular (schlangenförmige oberste Loa) dalam agama Voodoo Haiti.
claims.quote: Damballah, Damballa, Danbala oder Dam Ballah ist der schlangenförmige oberste Loa (Geist) in der haitianischen Religion des Voodoo.

claims.statement: Together with his wife Ayida Wédo (Frau Ayida Wédo), also shown as a rainbow serpent, he stands for the absolute divine in its male-female duality.
claims.statement_id: Bersama istrinya Ayida Wédo (Frau Ayida Wédo), yang juga digambarkan sebagai ular pelangi, ia melambangkan keilahian mutlak dalam dualitas laki-laki dan perempuan.
claims.quote: Gemeinsam mit seiner ebenfalls als Schlange (Regenbogenschlange) dargestellten Frau Ayida Wédo steht er für das absolut Göttliche in seiner männlich-weiblichen Dualität.

claims.statement: In Haiti, Damballah is offered an egg (Ei) in rituals, which he as a serpent crushes with his teeth.
claims.statement_id: Di Haiti, Damballah diberi persembahan telur (Ei) dalam ritual, yang ia remukkan dengan giginya sebagai ular.
claims.quote: Man opfert Damballah in Haiti in Ritualen ein Ei, das er als Schlange mit seinen Zähnen zerdrückt.

claims.statement: According to legend, Damballah in serpent form lives in a tree near a spring (Quelle) or enters a basin built for him.
claims.statement_id: Menurut legenda, Damballah dalam wujud ular tinggal di pohon dekat mata air (Quelle) atau masuk ke kolam yang dibangun untuknya.
claims.quote: Der Legende nach lebt Damballah in Schlangengestalt auf einem Baum in der Nähe einer Quelle oder er fährt in ein Becken, das man für ihn erbaut hat.

claims.statement: Damballah is the loa credited with creating the world and all other gods.
claims.statement_id: Damballah adalah loa yang dianggap menciptakan dunia dan semua dewa lain.
claims.quote: Damballah is the loa who is credited with the creation of the world and all other gods.

claims.statement: St. Patrick was identified with Damballah because he is commonly depicted with snakes.
claims.statement_id: St. Patrick disamakan dengan Damballah karena ia biasa digambarkan bersama ular (snakes).
claims.quote: St. Patrick was identified with Damhallah because he is commonly depicted with snakes.

claims.statement: A flag of Damballah or St. Patrick is part of the Cargo Collection at the Birmingham Museum of Art.
claims.statement_id: Sebuah bendera Damballah atau St. Patrick termasuk dalam Koleksi Cargo di Birmingham Museum of Art.
claims.quote: A flag of Damballah or St. Patrick, is one of those in the Cargo Collection at the Birmingham Museum of Art.

claims.statement: He represents the principle of good (principe du bien) and lives near rivers and springs (rivières et sources).
claims.statement_id: Ia mewakili prinsip kebaikan (principe du bien) dan tinggal dekat sungai dan mata air (rivières et sources).
claims.quote: Il représente le principe du bien, et vit près des rivières et des sources.

claims.statement: The Inkanyamba is a legendary creature in South African folklore.
claims.statement_id: Inkanyamba adalah makhluk legendaris dalam cerita rakyat Afrika Selatan (South African Folklore).
claims.quote: is a legendary creature in South African Folklore.

claims.statement: The sense of the name is not only the weather phenomenon but also the tornado spirit.
claims.statement_id: Makna namanya tidak hanya fenomena cuaca, tetapi juga mencakup roh tornado (tornado spirit).
claims.quote: The sense is not merely the physical weather phenomenon, but encompasses the tornado spirit.

claims.statement: Inkanyamba lore centres on several bodies of water, including the Umgeni and Umkomazi river systems in KwaZulu-Natal Province, South Africa.
claims.statement_id: Kisah inkanyamba terpusat di sejumlah perairan, termasuk sistem Sungai Umgeni dan Umkomazi di Provinsi KwaZulu-Natal, Afrika Selatan.
claims.quote: The lore of the inkanyamba is localized around several bodies of water, including the Umgeni River and Umkomazi River systems, in KwaZulu-Natal Province of South Africa.

claims.statement: It is especially said to live in the pool of Howick Falls on the Umgeni River and has a local nickname.
claims.statement_id: Makhluk ini terutama dikatakan tinggal di kolam Air Terjun Howick (Howick Falls) di Sungai Umgeni dan punya julukan lokal.
claims.quote: It is especially said to dwell in the pool of Howick Falls (on the Umgeni River), thus known locally by the nickname

claims.statement: The lore is also collected around Hogsback in Eastern Cape Province.
claims.statement_id: Kisahnya juga dikumpulkan di sekitar Hogsback, Provinsi Eastern Cape.
claims.quote: The lore is also collected around Hogsback in Eastern Cape Province.

claims.statement: Inkanyamba is described as a huge serpent or serpentine dragon whose coiling body stretches from heaven to earth.
claims.statement_id: Inkanyamba digambarkan sebagai ular raksasa atau naga berwujud ular (serpentine dragon) yang tubuhnya melilit dari langit sampai bumi.
claims.quote: Inkanyamba is described to be a huge serpent or serpentine dragon whose coiling body extends from heaven to earth;

claims.statement: In Zulu belief it is the root cause of tornados and a goddess of storm, water and hail.
claims.statement_id: Dalam kepercayaan Zulu, ia adalah penyebab tornado dan dewi badai, air, serta hujan es.
claims.quote: it is the root cause of tornados, a goddess of storm, water, and hail in Zulu belief.

claims.statement: A common interpretation depicts it as a serpentine creature with a horse-like or dragon-like head.
claims.statement_id: Gambaran umum menyebutnya makhluk berwujud ular dengan kepala mirip kuda atau naga.
claims.quote: A common interpretation depicts the cryptid as a serpentine creature with a horse-like or dragon-like head.

claims.statement: It is most active in the summer months, and its anger is believed to cause the seasonal storms.
claims.statement_id: Ia paling aktif pada bulan-bulan musim panas, dan amarahnya dipercaya menyebabkan badai musiman.
claims.quote: Most active in the summer months, it is believed that the inkanyamba's anger causes the seasonal storms.

claims.statement: Appeasing the Inkanyamba is also believed to calm its anger and bring rain and fertility.
claims.statement_id: Menenangkan Inkanyamba juga dipercaya meredakan amarahnya serta mendatangkan hujan dan kesuburan.
claims.quote: However, it's also believed that appeasing the Inkanyamba calms its anger and brings forth rain and fertility.

claims.statement: Local artisans made clay figurines showing the inkanyamba as monsters, often dragon-shaped, with horse or hog-like heads and wings.
claims.statement_id: Perajin setempat membuat patung tanah liat yang menggambarkan inkanyamba sebagai monster, sering berbentuk naga, berkepala kuda atau babi dan bersayap.
claims.quote: local artisans created clay figurines depicting the inkanyamba as monsters, often of dragon shape, with horse or hog-like heads and wings

claims.statement: Some commentators argue that witnesses actually saw only a crocodile or a giant eel.
claims.statement_id: Sebagian pengamat berpendapat para saksi sebenarnya hanya melihat buaya atau belut raksasa (crocodile or a giant eel).
claims.quote: Some commentators advocate the idea of mistaken identity by those who actually sighted only a crocodile or a giant eel.

claims.statement: In 1962 a game ranger, Buthelezi, claimed to see a horse-headed, serpent-bodied animal basking on a sandbank in the Umgeni River.
claims.statement_id: Pada 1962, seorang jagawana bernama Buthelezi mengaku melihat hewan berkepala kuda dan bertubuh ular berjemur di gosong pasir Sungai Umgeni.
claims.quote: In 1962, a game ranger, Buthelezi, claimed to see a horse-headed animal with a serpentine body basking on a sandbank in the Umgeni River

claims.statement: In Xhosa and Zulu mythology, the Inkanyamba is the deity of tornadoes, taking the form of a black snake.
claims.statement_id: Dalam mitologi Xhosa dan Zulu, Inkanyamba adalah dewa tornado yang berwujud ular hitam (black snake).
claims.quote: In Xhosa and Zulu mythology: the deity of tornadoes, taking the form of a black snake.

claims.statement: In southern Africa the tornado is represented as a long snake because it looks like a snake reaching from heaven to earth.
claims.statement_id: Di Afrika bagian selatan, tornado digambarkan sebagai ular panjang karena tampak seperti ular yang menjulur dari langit ke bumi.
claims.quote: In southern Africa it is represented in the shape of a long snake because that is what it looks like, a snake reaching from heaven to earth.

claims.statement: The Zulu name for this tornado deity is Inkanyamba.
claims.statement_id: Nama Zulu untuk dewa tornado ini adalah Inkanyamba.
claims.quote: The Zulu name for this deity is Inkanyamba.

claims.statement: The local Zulu tribes (zulúes) believe it is a very large serpent (serpiente) with a horse's head (caballo).
claims.statement_id: Suku-suku Zulu (zulúes) setempat percaya ia ular berukuran besar (serpiente) dengan kepala kuda (caballo).
claims.quote: Las tribus zulúes de la zona creen que es una serpiente de gran tamaño con una cabeza de caballo.

claims.statement: The Nandi bear is a cryptid purported to live in East Africa.
claims.statement_id: Beruang Nandi (Nandi bear) adalah kriptid yang konon hidup di Afrika Timur.
claims.quote: The Nandi bear is a cryptid purported to live in East Africa.

claims.statement: It takes its name from the Nandi people of western Kenya, the area where it has been reported.
claims.statement_id: Namanya diambil dari orang Nandi yang tinggal di Kenya barat, wilayah tempat beruang Nandi dilaporkan.
claims.quote: It takes its name from the Nandi people, who live in western Kenya, the area in which the Nandi bear has been reported.

claims.statement: The Samburu Nkampit also appears to be a version of this creature.
claims.statement_id: Nkampit dari orang Samburu tampaknya juga merupakan versi makhluk ini (version of this creature).
claims.quote: The Samburu Nkampit also appears to be a version of this creature.

claims.statement: Scientists tend to doubt the Nandi bear exists, arguing that the accounts are misinterpreted encounters with known animals.
claims.statement_id: Para ilmuwan cenderung meragukan keberadaan beruang Nandi dan menganggap laporannya sebagai salah tafsir atas pertemuan dengan hewan yang sudah dikenal.
claims.quote: Scientists tend to doubt the existence of the Nandi bear, arguing instead such accounts are misinterpreted encounters with known animals

claims.statement: The Nandi bear is described as a ferocious, powerfully built carnivore with high front shoulders.
claims.statement_id: Beruang Nandi digambarkan sebagai karnivora ganas bertubuh kuat dengan bahu depan yang tinggi (high front shoulders).
claims.quote: Descriptions of the Nandi bear are of a ferocious, powerfully built carnivore with high front shoulders

claims.statement: Local legend says the Nandi bear has reddish hair and long feet and is said to scalp people.
claims.statement_id: Menurut legenda setempat, beruang Nandi berbulu kemerahan, berkaki panjang, dan dikatakan menguliti kepala manusia (scalp people).
claims.quote: Local legend holds the Nandi bear has reddish hair, long feet and is said to scalp people.

claims.statement: Zoologist Reginald Innes Pocock claimed Nandi bear reports were misidentified hyenas, specifically the spotted hyena.
claims.statement_id: Zoolog Reginald Innes Pocock menyatakan laporan beruang Nandi adalah dubuk (hyenas) yang salah dikenali, khususnya dubuk tutul.
claims.quote: Zoologist Reginald Innes Pocock claimed reports of the Nandi bear were misidentified hyenas, specifically the spotted hyena.

claims.statement: In the 1930s Louis Leakey suggested Nandi bear descriptions matched the Chalicothere, though those extinct animals were herbivores.
claims.statement_id: Pada 1930-an Louis Leakey berpendapat deskripsi beruang Nandi cocok dengan Chalicothere, walaupun hewan punah itu pemakan tumbuhan (herbivores).
claims.quote: In the 1930s, Louis Leakey also suggested Nandi bear descriptions matched the Chalicothere, though those extinct creatures were herbivores.

claims.statement: Tarzan #134 (Gold Key Comics, March 1963) shows Tarzan meeting and later fighting a Nandi bear.
claims.statement_id: Komik Tarzan #134 (Gold Key Comics, Maret 1963) menampilkan Tarzan bertemu lalu bertarung dengan beruang Nandi (Nandi bear).
claims.quote: Tarzan #134 (Gold Key Comics, March 1963) features Tarzan meeting and later battling a Nandi bear

claims.statement: The Nandi people call it kerit.
claims.statement_id: Orang Nandi menyebutnya kerit.
claims.quote: The Nandi people call it kerit.

claims.statement: Among the strange animals reported from various parts of British East Africa is the chemosit or chimiset, or Nandi bear.
claims.statement_id: Di antara hewan aneh yang dilaporkan dari berbagai bagian British East Africa terdapat chemosit atau chimiset, yaitu beruang Nandi (Nandi bear).
claims.quote: Amongst the weird animals that have been reported from various parts of British East Africa is the chemosit or chimiset or Nandi bear.

claims.statement: In the agreeing stories the animal is fairly large, sometimes stands on its hind legs, is nocturnal, very fierce, and kills man or animals.
claims.statement_id: Menurut cerita yang saling cocok, hewan itu cukup besar, kadang berdiri dengan kaki belakang, aktif malam hari (nocturnal), sangat ganas, dan membunuh manusia atau hewan.
claims.quote: The animal is of fairly large size, it stands on its hind legs at times, is nocturnal, very fierce, kills man or animals.

claims.statement: The author knew of only one account of the animal being killed, and it came from the Maraquet district.
claims.statement_id: Penulis hanya mengetahui satu kisah tentang hewan itu dibunuh, dan kisah itu berasal dari distrik Maraquet.
claims.quote: There is only one account that I know of in which the animal has been killed, and that comes from the Maraquet district

claims.statement: It was killed by a group of men who put a dummy man in the doorway of a hut and waited inside until the animal came to take the dummy.
claims.statement_id: Hewan itu dibunuh oleh sekelompok pria yang menaruh boneka manusia (dummy man) di ambang pintu pondok lalu menunggu di dalam sampai hewan itu datang mengambilnya.
claims.quote: it was killed by a party of men who put a dummy man in the doorway of a hut and sat inside and waited till the animal came and tried to take the dummy

claims.statement: The author thought that among local people the stories were half legendary, kept alive by any case of people or cattle killed in an unusual way.
claims.statement_id: Menurut penulis, di kalangan penduduk setempat kisah-kisahnya setengah legenda (half legendary) dan tetap hidup karena setiap kasus orang atau ternak yang terbunuh secara tidak biasa.
claims.quote: amongst the natives the stories are, I think, half legendary and are kept alive by any cases of persons or cattle being killed in any out-of-the-way manner.

claims.statement: The strongest point for such an animal existing is that it has a native name and seems well known among the Nandi.
claims.statement_id: Alasan terkuat bahwa hewan itu ada adalah ia punya nama lokal (native name) dan tampak dikenal luas di kalangan orang Nandi.
claims.quote: The strongest point in favour of there being such an animal is that it has a native name, and appears to be well known amongst the Nandi.

claims.statement: The author's view was that the chimiset consists of a number of animals.
claims.statement_id: Penulis berpendapat chimiset sebenarnya gabungan dari sejumlah hewan (a number of animals).
claims.quote: My own view of the chimiset is that it consists of a number of animals.

claims.statement: The Nandi bear is an animal whose reality remains hypothetical (hypothétique) and which reportedly haunts the savannas of Tanzania and Kenya.
claims.statement_id: Beruang Nandi adalah hewan yang keberadaannya masih hipotetis (hypothétique) dan konon menghantui sabana Tanzania dan Kenya.
claims.quote: est un animal dont la réalité reste hypothétique et qui hanterait les savanes de Tanzanie et du Kenya.

claims.statement: It may also be called kerit, chimit, kikambungure, duba and sabroukoo.
claims.statement_id: Ia juga dikenal dengan nama kerit, chimit, kikambungure, duba, dan sabroukoo.
claims.quote: Il peut aussi porter les noms de kerit, chimit, kikambungure, duba et sabroukoo.

claims.statement: Local legend (leyenda local) holds that it eats only the brain (cerebro) of its victims.
claims.statement_id: Legenda setempat (leyenda local) menyatakan bahwa ia hanya memakan otak (cerebro) korbannya.
claims.quote: La leyenda local sostiene que solo come el cerebro de sus víctimas.

claims.statement: Some have speculated that the oso Nandi is actually a misidentified hyena (hiena) or a giant hyena surviving from the ice age.
claims.statement_id: Sebagian orang menduga oso Nandi sebenarnya dubuk (hiena) yang salah dikenali atau dubuk raksasa yang selamat dari zaman es.
claims.quote: Algunos han especulado que el oso Nandi es, de hecho, una hiena mal identificada o una hiena gigante superviviente de la edad de hielo.

claims.statement: The emela-ntouka is a legendary creature (creatura leggendaria) from the Likouala region of Central Africa.
claims.statement_id: Emela-ntouka adalah makhluk legendaris (creatura leggendaria) dari wilayah Likouala di Afrika Tengah.
claims.quote: è una creatura leggendaria dalla regione Likouala dell'Africa centrale.

claims.statement: The legend of the emela-ntouka comes from the mythology of the Pygmy tribes (tribù pigmee) living in Congo.
claims.statement_id: Legenda emela-ntouka berasal dari mitologi suku-suku Pigmi (tribù pigmee) yang tinggal di Kongo.
claims.quote: La leggenda dell'emela-ntouka deriva dalla mitologia delle tribù pigmee che vivono in Congo.

claims.statement: Although herbivorous (erbivoro), it reportedly often attacks large animals such as elephants, rhinoceroses or hippopotamuses (elefanti, rinoceronti, ippopotami) without devouring them.
claims.statement_id: Walaupun pemakan tumbuhan (erbivoro), ia konon sering menyerang hewan besar seperti gajah, badak, atau kuda nil (elefanti, rinoceronti, ippopotami) tanpa memakannya.
claims.quote: pur essendo erbivoro, attaccherebbe spesso animali di grossa taglia, come elefanti, rinoceronti o ippopotami, ma senza divorarli.

claims.statement: It is said to have greyish hairless skin, four sturdy legs and a tail like a crocodile's (coccodrillo).
claims.statement_id: Konon kulitnya keabu-abuan tanpa bulu, kakinya empat dan kokoh, dan ekornya mirip ekor buaya (coccodrillo).
claims.quote: Si dice che abbia la pelle grigiastra senza peli, quattro zampe robuste e una coda simile a un coccodrillo.

claims.statement: According to the Pygmies (Pigmei) and the witnesses, the creature is a little larger than an elephant (elefante).
claims.statement_id: Menurut orang Pigmi (Pigmei) dan para saksi, makhluk ini sedikit lebih besar daripada gajah (elefante).
claims.quote: Secondo i Pigmei e i testimoni che lo avrebbero visto, la creatura sarebbe un po' più grande di un elefante.

claims.statement: In the West (Occidente), the emela-ntouka was first mentioned in 1954 in an article in the journal Mammalia.
claims.statement_id: Di dunia Barat (Occidente), emela-ntouka pertama kali disebut pada 1954 dalam artikel di jurnal Mammalia.
claims.quote: In Occidente, l'emela-ntouka fu menzionato per la prima volta nel 1954 in un articolo sulla rivista britannica Mammalia.

claims.statement: The article, by Lucien Blancou, a former inspector of the Likouala region, describes the animal as larger than a bison (bisonte).
claims.statement_id: Artikel itu ditulis Lucien Blancou, mantan inspektur wilayah Likouala, dan menggambarkan hewan itu lebih besar daripada bison (bisonte).
claims.quote: Scritto da Lucien Blancou, un ex ispettore della regione di Likouala nell'Africa equatoriale francese, descrive l'animale come più grande di un bisonte

claims.statement: In 1980 and 1981 the cryptozoologist (criptozoologo) Roy Mackal led two expeditions to Congo in search of the mokele-mbembe.
claims.statement_id: Pada 1980 dan 1981, kriptozoolog (criptozoologo) Roy Mackal mengadakan dua ekspedisi ke Kongo untuk mencari mokele-mbembe.
claims.quote: Nel 1980 e nel 1981, un criptozoologo americano, Roy Mackal, organizzò due spedizioni in Congo alla ricerca del mokele-mbembe

claims.statement: During his expeditions he heard several testimonies (testimonianze) from men who claimed to have seen the emela-ntouka.
claims.statement_id: Dalam ekspedisinya ia mendengar beberapa kesaksian (testimonianze) orang yang mengaku pernah melihat emela-ntouka.
claims.quote: Nel corso delle sue spedizioni, ascoltò diverse testimonianze di uomini che affermavano di aver visto l'emela-ntouka

claims.statement: Some cryptozoologists (criptozoologi) think the emela-ntouka is a surviving dinosaur or an unknown large semi-aquatic mammal.
claims.statement_id: Sebagian kriptozoolog (criptozoologi) menganggap emela-ntouka dinosaurus yang bertahan hidup atau mamalia besar semi-akuatik yang belum dikenal.
claims.quote: Alcuni criptozoologi ritengono che l'emela-ntouka sia un dinosauro sopravvissuto o un grande mammifero semiacquatico sconosciuto.

claims.statement: Roy Mackal left open the possibility that the emela-ntouka is a Centrosaurus dinosaur that survived to the present day.
claims.statement_id: Roy Mackal membuka kemungkinan bahwa emela-ntouka adalah dinosaurus Centrosaurus yang bertahan sampai sekarang.
claims.quote: Roy Mackal lascia invece aperta la possibilità che l'emela-ntouka sia un dinosauro della specie Centrosaurus, sopravvissuto fino ai giorni nostri

claims.statement: Local people described a mysterious animal the size of an African elephant (非洲象), with sturdy limbs, brownish-grey skin and one large horn (角) on its forehead or nose.
claims.statement_id: Penduduk setempat menceritakan hewan misterius sebesar gajah Afrika (非洲象), berkaki kekar, berkulit cokelat keabu-abuan, dengan satu tanduk besar (角) di dahi atau hidung.
claims.quote: 当地人告诉他一种非洲象大小、有着粗壮四肢、棕灰色皮肤，额头或鼻子部位有着一个巨大的角的神秘动物。

claims.statement: Although herbivorous (植食性), the animal is extremely aggressive (极具攻击性) and attacks other large animals, killing them with its horn (角).
claims.statement_id: Walaupun herbivora (植食性), hewan ini sangat agresif (极具攻击性) dan menyerang hewan besar lain lalu membunuhnya dengan tanduknya (角).
claims.quote: 并且这种动物虽然是植食性，但却极具攻击性，会攻击其它大型动物，利用牠的角将对方杀死。

claims.statement: According to researcher Loren Coleman (洛伦·科尔曼), the emela-ntouka is not a dinosaur (恐龙) but an unrecognised new species of rhinoceros (犀牛).
claims.statement_id: Menurut peneliti Loren Coleman (洛伦·科尔曼), emela-ntouka bukan dinosaurus (恐龙), melainkan spesies badak (犀牛) baru yang belum dikenali.
claims.quote: 动物学、人类学与神秘动物学研究者洛伦·科尔曼 ... 认为，埃米拉·恩图卡并非恐龙，而是一种未被确认的新种犀牛。

claims.statement: Zoologist Loren Coleman leans toward the view that the creature is a giant prehistoric rhinoceros (rinoceronte gigante).
claims.statement_id: Zoolog Loren Coleman lebih condong pada pandangan bahwa makhluk itu badak raksasa (rinoceronte gigante) dari zaman prasejarah.
claims.quote: Lo zoologo americano Loren Coleman è più propenso alla versione che vede nella creatura un rinoceronte gigante di epoca preistorica

claims.statement: In the Lingala language its name means elephant killer (tueur d'éléphants), supposedly from its aggressive way of life.
claims.statement_id: Dalam bahasa Lingala, namanya berarti pembunuh gajah (tueur d'éléphants), konon karena cara hidupnya yang agresif.
claims.quote: Son nom, en langage lingala, signifie tueur d'éléphants et viendrait de son mode de vie agressif.

claims.statement: The Sasabonsam is a vampire-like folkloric being of the Akan people.
claims.statement_id: Sasabonsam adalah makhluk cerita rakyat mirip vampir (vampire-like) dari orang Akan.
claims.quote: is a vampire-like folkloric being from the Akan people.

claims.statement: It belongs to the folklore of the Akan of southern Ghana, as well as Côte d'Ivoire and Togo.
claims.statement_id: Makhluk ini termasuk cerita rakyat orang Akan di Ghana selatan, juga di Côte d'Ivoire dan Togo.
claims.quote: It belongs to the folklore of the Akan of southern Ghana, as well as Côte d'Ivoire, Togo

claims.statement: It was also known in 18th century Jamaica through enslaved Akan.
claims.statement_id: Cerita ini juga dikenal di Jamaika abad ke-18 melalui orang Akan yang diperbudak (enslaved Akan).
claims.quote: and 18th century Jamaica from enslaved Akan.

claims.statement: It is said to have iron teeth and long hair, to live in trees and to attack from above.
claims.statement_id: Konon ia bergigi besi (iron teeth), berambut panjang, tinggal di pohon, dan menyerang dari atas.
claims.quote: It is said to have iron teeth and long hair and lives in trees, attacking from above.

claims.statement: They claim territory in forest trees, where they live and feed on people who wander into their home.
claims.statement_id: Mereka menguasai wilayah di pepohonan hutan (forests), tempat mereka hidup dan memangsa orang yang masuk ke wilayahnya.
claims.quote: They take up territory in the trees in the forests, where they live and feed on people that wander into their home.

claims.statement: Though humanoid, these creatures have bat-like features, including wings nearly 20 feet wide.
claims.statement_id: Walau berwujud mirip manusia, makhluk ini punya ciri kelelawar, termasuk sayap yang lebarnya hampir 20 kaki (20 feet).
claims.quote: While being humanoid, these creatures have bat-like features, including wings which can be nearly 20 feet wide.

claims.statement: In mythology it is usually portrayed as an archetypical ogre.
claims.statement_id: Dalam mitologi ia biasanya digambarkan sebagai raksasa pemakan manusia yang khas (archetypical ogre).
claims.quote: In mythology, it is usually portrayed as an archetypical ogre

claims.statement: The hairy Sasabonsam has large blood-shot eyes, long legs and feet pointing both ways.
claims.statement_id: Sasabonsam yang berbulu digambarkan bermata besar merah (blood-shot eyes), berkaki panjang, dengan telapak kaki menghadap dua arah.
claims.quote: the hairy Sasabonsam has large blood-shot eyes, long legs, and feet pointing both ways.

claims.statement: Its favourite trick is to sit on high branches and dangle its legs to entangle the unwary hunter.
claims.statement_id: Tipu dayanya yang paling disukai adalah duduk di dahan tinggi dan menjuntaikan kaki untuk menjerat pemburu (hunter) yang lengah.
claims.quote: Its favourite trick is to sit on the high branches of a tree and dangle its legs so as to entangle the unwary hunter.

claims.statement: The Asante of Ghana called the iron-toothed tree dweller the asasabonsam.
claims.statement_id: Orang Asante di Ghana menyebut penghuni pohon bergigi besi ini asasabonsam.
claims.quote: The Asante of Ghana called the iron-toothed tree dweller the asasabonsam.

claims.statement: According to the author, Srahmantin and Sasabonsum each seem to be the name of a genus of deities.
claims.statement_id: Menurut penulis, Srahmantin dan Sasabonsum tampaknya masing-masing nama satu golongan dewa (genus of deities).
claims.quote: Properly speaking, it seems as if Srahmantin and Sasabonsum were each a name of a genus of deities

claims.statement: Sasabonsum is the friend of wizards and witches, a monstrous being of human shape and red colour.
claims.statement_id: Sasabonsum adalah sahabat para penyihir (wizards and witches), makhluk mengerikan berwujud manusia dan berwarna merah.
claims.quote: Sasabonsum is the friend of wizards and witches, and is a monstrous being, of human shape and red colour,

claims.statement: He has a taste for human flesh and waylays and devours solitary wayfarers.
claims.statement_id: Ia gemar daging manusia, menghadang, dan melahap pengelana yang berjalan sendirian (solitary wayfarers).
claims.quote: He has a propensity for human flesh, and he waylays and devours solitary wayfarers.

claims.statement: He is the most cruel and malevolent of all the gods and delights in destroying anyone who has offended him.
claims.statement_id: Ia dewa paling kejam dan jahat (malevolent) dan senang membinasakan siapa pun yang menyinggungnya.
claims.quote: He is the most cruel and malevolent of all the gods, and takes delight in destroying all those who have offended him

claims.statement: He is believed to be implacable and, once angered, can never be appeased.
claims.statement_id: Ia dipercaya tidak dapat diredakan (implacable); sekali marah, ia tidak bisa ditenangkan.
claims.quote: He is believed to be implacable ; and, once angered, can never be mollified or propitiated.

claims.statement: He lives in the darkest recesses of the forest where the earth is red.
claims.statement_id: Ia tinggal di bagian hutan (forest) yang paling gelap tempat tanahnya merah.
claims.quote: He either resides in the darkest and gloomiest recesses of the forest where the earth is red

claims.statement: Every spot with red earth is believed to be or to have been a Sasabonsum's abode, the red being caused by the blood of his victims.
claims.statement_id: Setiap tempat bertanah merah dipercaya pernah menjadi tempat tinggal Sasabonsum, dan warna merahnya dianggap berasal dari darah korbannya (blood of the victims).
claims.quote: Every spot where the earth is of a red colour is believed to be, or to have been, the place of abode of a Sasabonsum ; and the red colour is supposed to be caused by the blood of the victims destroyed by him.

claims.statement: One who lives in the earth shakes it so that houses collapse on their occupants; in short, he is an earthquake god.
claims.statement_id: Sasabonsum yang tinggal di dalam tanah mengguncangnya sehingga rumah runtuh menimpa penghuninya; singkatnya ia dewa gempa (earthquake god).
claims.quote: one who lives in the earth, by shaking it or upheaving it, so that the houses fall in and crush the occupants. The latter is, in short, an earthquake god

claims.statement: A Sasabonsum living in or near a bombax shows his malignity by throwing it down on passers-by.
claims.statement_id: Sasabonsum yang tinggal di atau dekat pohon randu (bombax) menunjukkan kejahatannya dengan merobohkan pohon itu ke atas orang yang lewat.
claims.quote: A Sasabonsum who lives in or near a bombax, displays his maligaity by throwing it down upon passers-by

claims.statement: The author thought belief in the Sasabonsum living among the bombaces arose from frequent deaths caused by these trees falling.
claims.statement_id: Menurut penulis, kepercayaan pada Sasabonsum penghuni pohon randu (bombaces) muncul karena seringnya korban jiwa akibat tumbangnya pohon-pohon itu.
claims.quote: the belief in Srahmantin and the Sasabonsum who resides amongst the bombaces, is due to the frequent loss of life caused by the falling of such trees.

claims.statement: In 1881 a slight earthquake shock threw down part of the wall of the king's residence in Coomassie.
claims.statement_id: Pada 1881 guncangan gempa kecil merobohkan sebagian dinding kediaman raja di Coomassie.
claims.quote: In 1881, a slight earthquake shock threw down a portion of the wall of the king's residence in Coomassie.

claims.statement: The priests declared that the damage was the act of Sasabonsum.
claims.statement_id: Para pendeta menyatakan bahwa kerusakan itu adalah perbuatan Sasabonsum (act of Sasabonsum).
claims.quote: the latter declared that the damage was the act of Sasabonsum

claims.statement: Asanbosam is a vampire-like fabulous being (Vampiren ähnliches Fabelwesen) told of by the Aschanti of southern Ghana.
claims.statement_id: Asanbosam adalah makhluk dongeng mirip vampir (Vampiren ähnliches Fabelwesen) yang diceritakan oleh orang Aschanti di Ghana selatan.
claims.quote: Asanbosam ist ein Vampiren ähnliches Fabelwesen, von dem die im Süden Ghanas lebenden Aschanti

claims.statement: Among them there are said to be men, women and children, all with iron teeth (Zähne aus Eisen), legs with hook-like projections and six arms (sechs Arme).
claims.statement_id: Konon di antara mereka ada laki-laki, perempuan, dan anak-anak, semuanya bergigi besi (Zähne aus Eisen), berkaki dengan tonjolan seperti kait, dan berlengan enam (sechs Arme).
claims.quote: Es soll bei ihnen Männer, Frauen und Kinder geben, die alle Zähne aus Eisen, Beine mit hakenartigen Fortsätzen und sechs Arme haben.

claims.statement: The asanbosam is said to have iron teeth and feet in the form of iron hooks.
claims.statement_id: Asanbosam dikatakan memiliki gigi besi dan kaki berupa pengait besi.
claims.quote: Dikatakan bahwa asanbosam memiliki gigi besi dan kakinya berupa pengait besi.

claims.statement: The adze is a vampiric being in Ewe folklore.
claims.statement_id: Adze adalah makhluk vampir (vampiric being) dalam cerita rakyat Ewe.
claims.quote: The adze is a vampiric being in Ewe folklore,

claims.statement: It is told by the people of Togo and Ghana.
claims.statement_id: Kisahnya dituturkan oleh masyarakat Togo dan Ghana.
claims.quote: told by the people of Togo and Ghana.

claims.statement: In the wild the adze takes the form of a firefly, but it changes into human shape when captured.
claims.statement_id: Di alam liar adze berwujud kunang-kunang (firefly), tetapi berubah ke wujud manusia bila tertangkap.
claims.quote: In the wild, the adze takes the form of a firefly, though it will transform into human shape upon capture.

claims.statement: In human form the adze has the power to possess humans.
claims.statement_id: Dalam wujud manusia, adze mampu merasuki (possess) manusia.
claims.quote: When in human form, the adze has the power to possess humans.

claims.statement: People, male or female, possessed by an adze are viewed as witches.
claims.statement_id: Orang, laki-laki atau perempuan, yang dirasuki adze dipandang sebagai penyihir (witches).
claims.quote: People, male or female, possessed by an adze are viewed as witches

claims.statement: The adze's influence harms the people living around its host.
claims.statement_id: Pengaruh adze berdampak buruk pada orang-orang di sekitar inangnya (host).
claims.quote: The adze's influence would negatively affect the people who lived around their host.

claims.statement: People are suspected of possession in various situations: women whose brothers' children fare better, old people when the young suddenly die, and the poor who envy the rich.
claims.statement_id: Kecurigaan kerasukan muncul dalam berbagai keadaan, misalnya pada perempuan yang anak-anak saudara laki-lakinya lebih beruntung, orang tua ketika kaum muda mendadak meninggal, dan orang miskin yang iri pada orang kaya (envied the rich).
claims.quote: A person is suspected of being possessed in a variety of situations, including: women with brothers (especially if their brother's children fared better than their own), old people (if the young suddenly started dying and the old stayed alive) and the poor (if they envied the rich).

claims.statement: In firefly form the adze travels at night through keyholes, cracks in walls or under closed doors.
claims.statement_id: Dalam wujud kunang-kunang, adze bergerak pada malam hari (at night) melalui lubang kunci, celah dinding, atau kolong pintu tertutup.
claims.quote: In firefly form, the adze would travel through keyholes, cracks in walls, or under closed doors at night.

claims.statement: Once inside the home it sucks the blood of sleepers, making them fall sick and die.
claims.statement_id: Setelah masuk rumah (home), ia mengisap darah orang yang tidur sehingga mereka sakit dan mati.
claims.quote: Once in the home, it would suck blood from people as they slept, making them fall sick and die.

claims.statement: Tales of the creature were probably an attempt to describe the deadly effects of mosquitoes and malaria.
claims.statement_id: Kisah makhluk ini kemungkinan merupakan upaya menjelaskan dampak mematikan nyamuk dan malaria (mosquitoes and malaria).
claims.quote: Tales of the creature and its effects were probably an attempt to describe the potentially deadly effects of mosquitoes and malaria.

claims.statement: There is no defense against an adze.
claims.statement_id: Tidak ada perlindungan (no defense) terhadap adze.
claims.quote: There is no defense against an adze.

claims.statement: The adze is a vampiric spirit being (vampirisches Geistwesen) originating in the mythology of the Ewe, a West African people (Ghana, Togo, Benin).
claims.statement_id: Adze adalah makhluk roh vampir (vampirisches Geistwesen) yang berasal dari mitologi Ewe, suku bangsa Afrika Barat (Ghana, Togo, Benin).
claims.quote: Adze ist ein vampirisches Geistwesen, welches in der Mythologie der Ewe, einer Volksgruppe Westafrikas (Ghana, Togo, Benin), seinen Ursprung hat.

claims.statement: It especially sucks the blood of children (Kindern) but is also known to drink coconut milk or palm oil (Kokosmilch oder Palmöl), which was therefore used to hunt it and to protect against it.
claims.statement_id: Ia terutama mengisap darah anak-anak (Kindern), tetapi juga dikenal meminum santan atau minyak sawit (Kokosmilch oder Palmöl), sehingga bahan itu dipakai untuk memburu dan melindungi diri darinya.
claims.quote: Er saugt besonders Kindern das Blut aus, ist aber auch bekannt dafür, Kokosmilch oder Palmöl zu trinken, welches daher für die Jagd auf und den Schutz vor ihm verwendet wurde.

claims.statement: Matthew Bunson links the adze tales to the effects of mosquitoes and malaria (moustiques et paludisme).
claims.statement_id: Matthew Bunson mengaitkan kisah adze dengan dampak nyamuk dan malaria (moustiques et paludisme).
claims.quote: Matthew Bunson rapproche les récits sur l'adze des effets des moustiques et du paludisme

claims.statement: It differs from the European vampire (vampire européen) through its insect form, its link with possession and its association with witchcraft.
claims.statement_id: Adze berbeda dari vampir Eropa (vampire européen) karena wujud serangganya, kaitannya dengan kerasukan, dan hubungannya dengan sihir.
claims.quote: Il se distingue cependant du vampire européen par sa forme d'insecte, son lien avec la possession et son association à la sorcellerie.

claims.statement: It can enter houses (maisons) through keyholes, cracks in walls, windows or under closed doors.
claims.statement_id: Ia dapat masuk ke rumah (maisons) lewat lubang kunci, celah dinding, jendela, atau kolong pintu tertutup.
claims.quote: Il peut entrer dans les maisons par les trous de serrure, les fissures des murs, les fenêtres ou sous les portes fermées

claims.statement: Anzar is a god (dios) of Berber (bereber) mythology in North Africa, god of rain and water (lluvia y el agua).
claims.statement_id: Anzar adalah dewa (dios) dalam mitologi Berber (bereber) di Afrika Utara, dewa hujan dan air (lluvia y el agua).
claims.quote: Anzar es un dios de la mitología bereber del Norte de África, dios de la lluvia y el agua

claims.statement: Anzar, often called Agellid n Ugfur (the King of Rain, El rey de la lluvia), is the god of the sky, waters, rivers, seas, streams, springs and rain.
claims.statement_id: Anzar, yang sering disebut Agellid n Ugfur (Raja Hujan, El rey de la lluvia), adalah dewa langit, perairan, sungai, laut, anak sungai, mata air, dan hujan.
claims.quote: Anzar, a menudo llamado Agellid n Ugfur (El rey de la lluvia), es el dios del cielo, las aguas, los ríos, los mares, los arroyos, las fuentes y de la lluvia.

claims.statement: In North Africa a rite called Tislit n Anzar (the Bride of Anzar, La novia de Anzar) is dedicated to him in times of drought (sequía) to ask for rain.
claims.statement_id: Di Afrika Utara ada ritus untuknya bernama Tislit n Anzar (Pengantin Anzar, La novia de Anzar) yang dilakukan saat kemarau (sequía) untuk meminta hujan.
claims.quote: En el norte de África se dedica a él un rito conocido como Tislit n Anzar (La novia de Anzar) durante los períodos de sequía para solicitar la lluvia.

claims.statement: This tradition is attested in the Rif, Kabylia (Cabilia), the Atlas, Ouarsenis and the Aurès.
claims.statement_id: Tradisi ini tercatat di Rif, Kabylia (Cabilia), Atlas, Ouarsenis, dan Aurès.
claims.quote: Esta tradición ha sido atestiguada en el Rif, en Cabilia, en el Atlas, a Ouarsenis y a los Aurès.

claims.statement: In the legend the Lord of Water (Señor del agua) turned the ring (anillo) on his finger, and the river (río) suddenly dried up and vanished.
claims.statement_id: Dalam legenda, Penguasa Air (Señor del agua) memutar cincin (anillo) di jarinya sehingga sungai (río) mendadak kering dan lenyap.
claims.quote: Con estas palabras, el Señor del agua de repente giró el anillo que llevaba en el dedo, el río se secó repentinamente y desapareció.

claims.statement: The girl (la chica) saw the Lord of Water appear in the form of lightning (rayo) and clung to him.
claims.statement_id: Gadis itu (la chica) melihat Penguasa Air muncul dalam rupa kilat (rayo) dan memeluknya erat.
claims.quote: Inmediatamente la chica vio aparecer al Señor de agua con el aspecto de un rayo y se aferró a él.

claims.statement: Anzar is an ancient Berber word (antigua palabra bereber) still used with a particular meaning in some regions.
claims.statement_id: Anzar adalah kata Berber kuno (antigua palabra bereber) yang di beberapa daerah masih dipakai dengan makna tertentu.
claims.quote: Anzar es una antigua palabra bereber que en algunas regiones todavía se utiliza en el significado de

claims.statement: To obtain rain (pioggia) that is slow to come, people appeal to Anzar and do everything to provoke his fertilising intervention (intervento fecondatore).
claims.statement_id: Untuk mendatangkan hujan (pioggia) yang lama tak turun, orang memohon kepada Anzar dan berupaya memicu campur tangannya yang menyuburkan (intervento fecondatore).
claims.quote: Per ottenere la pioggia che tarda a venire, si sollecita Anzar e si fa di tutto per provocare il suo intervento fecondatore.

claims.statement: Anzar strengthens vegetation, favours harvests (raccolti) and ensures the growth of flocks (greggi).
claims.statement_id: Anzar menguatkan tumbuhan, mendukung panen (raccolti), dan menjamin bertambahnya ternak (greggi).
claims.quote: rinforza la vegetazione, favorisce i raccolti e assicura la crescita delle greggi.

claims.statement: Today a kind of doll (bambola) is made from a ladle and two spoons (mestolo e due cucchiai).
claims.statement_id: Kini dibuat semacam boneka (bambola) dari sebuah sendok sayur dan dua sendok (mestolo e due cucchiai).
claims.quote: oggi si confeziona, con un mestolo e due cucchiai, una sorta di bambola.

claims.statement: Anzar is the (masculine) name of rain (pioggia) in Berber (berbero).
claims.statement_id: Anzar adalah nama (maskulin) untuk hujan (pioggia) dalam bahasa Berber (berbero).
claims.quote: Anzar è infatti il nome (maschile) della pioggia in berbero

claims.statement: In the legend Anzar wished to marry a girl (fanciulla) of rare beauty.
claims.statement_id: Menurut legenda, Anzar ingin menikahi seorang gadis (fanciulla) yang sangat cantik.
claims.quote: Egli desiderava sposare una fanciulla di rara bellezza

claims.statement: The girl (ragazza) burst into tears, and after Anzar returned the whole earth (terra) regained its springtime splendour.
claims.statement_id: Gadis itu (ragazza) menangis, dan setelah Anzar kembali seluruh bumi (terra) memperoleh lagi semarak musim seminya.
claims.quote: La ragazza si sciolse in lacrime, e pianse. ... e tutta la terra riprende il suo splendore primaverile.

claims.statement: H. Genevois's ethnographic text (1978) describes these rites and myths in detail in a village of Cabilia (Algeria).
claims.statement_id: Teks etnografis H. Genevois (1978) menjelaskan secara rinci ritus dan mitos ini di sebuah desa di Cabilia (Algeria).
claims.quote: testo etnografico di H. Genevois (1978) che descrive con molti dettagli questi riti e i miti ad essi connessi in un villaggio della Cabilia (Algeria).

claims.statement: Many consider it likely that Anzar was an ancient deity of water and rain (divinità dell'acqua e della pioggia).
claims.statement_id: Banyak yang menganggap Anzar kemungkinan dewa kuno air dan hujan (divinità dell'acqua e della pioggia).
claims.quote: molti considerano probabile che Anzar fosse un'antica divinità dell'acqua e della pioggia

claims.statement: However, the name does not appear among the many deities (divinità) handed down by ancient Greek and Latin (greci e latini) texts.
claims.statement_id: Namun nama itu tidak tercantum di antara dewa-dewa (divinità) yang tercatat dalam teks kuno berbahasa Yunani dan Latin (greci e latini).
claims.quote: anche se tale nome non figura tra le molte divinità nordafricane tramandateci dai testi greci e latini dell'antichità

claims.statement: The bride in the rite is today replaced by a kind of doll (bambola), often made from a wooden spoon (cucchiaio di legno).
claims.statement_id: Pengantin dalam ritus kini digantikan semacam boneka (bambola), sering dibuat dari sendok kayu (cucchiaio di legno).
claims.quote: oggi sostituita da una specie di bambola, spesso ricavata da un cucchiaio di legno

claims.statement: Today the rite is partly integrated into Islam (religione islamica), and the procession usually involves sacred places such as shrines or tombs of local marabouts.
claims.statement_id: Kini ritus itu sebagian telah terintegrasi ke dalam agama Islam (religione islamica), dan prosesinya biasanya melewati tempat suci seperti makam marabut setempat.
claims.quote: Oggi il rito è stato in parte integrato nella religione islamica e la processione coinvolge di solito luoghi sacri come santuari o tombe di marabutti locali.

claims.statement: The Berber term Tislit n Wanzar is also the name of the rainbow (arcobaleno), which usually accompanies rain.
claims.statement_id: Istilah Berber Tislit n Wanzar juga menjadi nama pelangi (arcobaleno) yang biasanya menyertai hujan.
claims.quote: Il termine berbero Tislit n Wanzar ... è anche il nome dell'arcobaleno, che di norma accompagna le precipitazioni.

claims.statement: The term has become the name for rain (pluie), attested in all present-day Berber (berbères) dialects.
claims.statement_id: Istilah itu telah menjadi sebutan bagi hujan (pluie) dan tercatat di semua dialek Berber (berbères) masa kini.
claims.quote: Le terme est devenu la dénomination de la pluie, attestée dans tous les dialectes berbères actuels

claims.statement: In Zulu mythology Mamlambo is a female water spirit, usually in the form of a snake or a woman, requiring sacrifice, sometimes of human life, in return for her favour.
claims.statement_id: Dalam mitologi Zulu, Mamlambo adalah roh air perempuan (female water spirit), biasanya berwujud ular atau perempuan, yang menuntut korban, kadang nyawa manusia, sebagai imbalan kemurahannya.
claims.quote: In Zulu mythology: a female water spirit, usually in the form of a snake or a woman requiring sacrifice, sometimes of human life, in return for her favour.

claims.statement: Mamlambo demands a sacrifice before granting her favours to a man, taking the form of someone in his family dying.
claims.statement_id: Mamlambo menuntut korban (sacrifice) sebelum memberi kemurahan kepada seorang pria, berupa kematian salah satu anggota keluarganya.
claims.quote: The Mamlambo demands a sacrifice before she bestows her favours on a man, and this penalty or sacrifice takes the form of someone dying in his family.

claims.statement: It is known to assume different shapes, appearing at times as a baboon, a skunk or a wild pig, but just as likely as a lovely woman; it is always female.
claims.statement_id: Mamlambo dikenal berganti wujud: kadang tampak sebagai babun, sigung, atau babi hutan (baboon, skunk, wild pig), tetapi bisa juga perempuan cantik; ia selalu perempuan.
claims.quote: it is well known to assume different shapes; at times it appears as a baboon, or a skunk, or a wild pig, but it is just as likely to be a lovely woman. It is always female.

claims.statement: Mamlambo, the mother of the river, is a mythical snake living under the water in river pools, who leaves the river as a beautiful woman.
claims.statement_id: Mamlambo, ibu sungai (mother of the river), adalah ular mitos yang tinggal di bawah air di lubuk sungai dan keluar dari sungai sebagai perempuan cantik.
claims.quote: Mamlambo the mother of the river is a mythical snake that lives under the water in river pools. She escapes from the river as a beautiful woman.

claims.statement: Mamlambo is a kind of snake that brings fortune to anyone who keeps it.
claims.statement_id: Mamlambo adalah sejenis ular yang membawa keberuntungan (fortune) bagi siapa pun yang memeliharanya.
claims.quote: Mamlambo is a kind of snake that brings fortune to anyone who accommodates it.

claims.statement: This snake can be obtained from traditional doctors.
claims.statement_id: Ular ini bisa diperoleh dari dukun tradisional (traditional doctors).
claims.quote: This snake is available from traditional doctors

claims.statement: She is the goddess of the rivers of Natal and appears to those who sacrifice to her.
claims.statement_id: Ia adalah dewi sungai-sungai di Natal (goddess of the rivers) dan menampakkan diri kepada orang yang memberinya persembahan.
claims.quote: she is the goddess of the rivers of Natal and will appear to those who sacrifice to her.

claims.statement: Villagers in the area claimed the creature was about 20 meters long.
claims.statement_id: Penduduk desa di daerah itu mengaku makhluk tersebut panjangnya sekitar 20 meter (20 meters).
claims.quote: Villagers in the area claimed that the creature was about 20 meters

claims.statement: Between January and April 1997, as many as nine deaths were attributed to the Mamlambo.
claims.statement_id: Antara Januari dan April 1997, sebanyak sembilan kematian (nine deaths) dikaitkan dengan Mamlambo.
claims.quote: During the period between January and April 1997, as many as nine deaths had been attributed to the Mamlambo.

claims.statement: According to police, the victims had been in the water a while and crabs had eaten the soft parts of their heads and necks.
claims.statement_id: Menurut polisi (police), para korban sudah lama berada di air dan bagian lunak kepala serta leher mereka dimakan kepiting (crabs).
claims.quote: According to police, the victims had been in the water a while and had the soft parts of their heads and neck eaten by crabs

claims.statement: According to Felicity Wood, the mamlambo tends to be associated with Western forms of prosperity, such as money.
claims.statement_id: Menurut Felicity Wood, mamlambo cenderung dikaitkan dengan bentuk kemakmuran gaya Barat (Western forms of prosperity), seperti uang.
claims.quote: the mamlambo tends to be associated with Western forms of prosperity, like money

claims.statement: Like Mami Wata, she is a dangerous, seductive figure, offering wealth and power but able to bring terrifying ruin.
claims.statement_id: Seperti Mami Wata, ia sosok yang berbahaya dan memikat (dangerous, seductive), menawarkan kekayaan dan kekuasaan tetapi bisa mendatangkan kehancuran mengerikan.
claims.quote: Like the Mami Wata, she is a dangerous, seductive figure, offering wealth and power but able to bring about terrifying ruin

claims.statement: The Mamlambo myth drew the interest of cryptozoologists (cryptozoologos) in 1997, when some newspapers (periódicos) reported sightings.
claims.statement_id: Mitos Mamlambo menarik minat para kriptozoolog (cryptozoologos) pada 1997, ketika sejumlah surat kabar (periódicos) melaporkan penampakannya.
claims.quote: El mito de Mamlambo se volvió de interés para los cryptozoologos en 1997, cuando algunos periódicos sudafricanos

claims.statement: The sightings were reported in the Mzintlava River near Mount Ayliff (Monte Ayliff), South Africa (Sudáfrica).
claims.statement_id: Penampakan dilaporkan di Sungai Mzintlava dekat Gunung Ayliff (Monte Ayliff), Afrika Selatan (Sudáfrica).
claims.quote: en el Río Mzintlava cerca del Monte Ayliff; Sudáfrica.

claims.statement: According to villagers the monster had a horse's head (caballo), the lower body of a fish (pez), short legs and a snake's neck (serpiente).
claims.statement_id: Menurut penduduk, monster itu berkepala kuda (caballo), bertubuh bawah ikan (pez), berkaki pendek, dan berleher ular (serpiente).
claims.quote: tenía cabeza de caballo, la parte inferior de un pez, piernas cortas, y el cuello de serpiente,

claims.statement: It was also reported that the monster had killed 9 people (9 personas).
claims.statement_id: Dilaporkan pula bahwa monster itu telah membunuh 9 orang (9 personas).
claims.quote: También se reportó que el monstruo había matado a 9 personas.

claims.statement: The villagers (pobladores), on the other hand, claimed these mutilations were caused by Mamlambo's habit of eating faces (comer caras).
claims.statement_id: Sebaliknya, penduduk (pobladores) menyatakan luka-luka itu disebabkan kebiasaan Mamlambo memakan wajah (comer caras).
claims.quote: los pobladores, por otro lado, aclamaban que estas mutilaciones habían sido causadas por el hábito de Mamlambo de comer caras

claims.statement: The Grootslang is a legendary creature reputed to dwell in a deep cave in the Richtersveld, South Africa.
claims.statement_id: Grootslang adalah makhluk legendaris (legendary creature) yang konon tinggal di gua dalam di Richtersveld, Afrika Selatan.
claims.quote: is a legendary creature that is reputed to dwell in a deep cave in the Richtersveld, South Africa.

claims.statement: The Grootslang is said to be a huge serpent dwelling in a cave.
claims.statement_id: Grootslang dikatakan sebagai ular raksasa (huge serpent) yang tinggal di sebuah gua.
claims.quote: The Grootslang is said to be a huge serpent that dwells in a cave known as the

claims.statement: According to local legend, the cave is full of diamonds.
claims.statement_id: Menurut legenda setempat, gua itu penuh berlian (diamonds).
claims.quote: According to local legend, the cave is filled with diamonds.

claims.statement: In a version reported by Jon Manchip White as told by the Bushmen, the Grootslang is older than the world and will guard its treasure for eternity.
claims.statement_id: Menurut satu versi yang dilaporkan Jon Manchip White dari cerita orang Bushmen, Grootslang lebih tua daripada dunia dan akan menjaga hartanya (treasure) selamanya.
claims.quote: According to a version of the story reported by Jon Manchip White as being told by the Bushmen, the Grootslang is older than the world and will protect its treasure for eternity.

claims.statement: Belief in this creature is described as ubiquitous among the local Khoekhoe.
claims.statement_id: Kepercayaan pada makhluk ini digambarkan tersebar luas di kalangan orang Khoekhoe setempat.
claims.quote: Belief in this creature is described as ubiquitous among the local Khoekhoe

claims.statement: In 1917 the English businessman Peter Grayson disappeared while hunting treasure in the Richtersveld after lions attacked his party, prompting rumours that the Grootslang had killed him.
claims.statement_id: Pada 1917 pengusaha Inggris (English) Peter Grayson hilang saat mencari harta di Richtersveld setelah rombongannya diserang singa, sehingga beredar desas-desus bahwa Grootslang membunuhnya.
claims.quote: While searching for treasure in the Richtersveld of South Africa in 1917, the English businessman Peter Grayson disappeared after members of his party were attacked and injured by lions, prompting rumours that the Grootslang had killed him.

claims.statement: An unverified myth spread online tells of the Grootslang being created by gods or God at the dawn of creation.
claims.statement_id: Sebuah mitos yang tidak terverifikasi dan beredar daring (unverified myth spread online) menceritakan Grootslang diciptakan oleh para dewa atau Tuhan pada awal penciptaan.
claims.quote: One unverified myth spread online tells of the Grootslang being created by either gods or God at the dawn of creation

claims.statement: In media from the 21st century onwards, the Grootslang has often been given elephant features such as a trunked, tusked head or four legs.
claims.statement_id: Dalam media sejak abad ke-21 (21st century), Grootslang sering diberi ciri gajah, seperti kepala berbelalai dan bergading atau empat kaki.
claims.quote: In media from the 21st century onwards, the Grootslang has commonly adapted features of elephants, such as giving it a trunked and tusked head or four legs.

claims.statement: This comes from author Carol Rose describing the Grootslang as being as big as an elephant.
claims.statement_id: Ciri itu berasal dari penulis Carol Rose yang menyebut Grootslang sebesar gajah (as big as an elephant).
claims.quote: This originates from author Carol Rose describing the Grootslang as being as big as an elephant

claims.statement: The guide told the author that in the middle of the river, opposite the camp, was a big rock where the huge snake lived.
claims.statement_id: Pemandu memberi tahu penulis bahwa di tengah sungai, tepat di seberang perkemahan, ada batu besar tempat ular raksasa (huge snake) itu tinggal.
claims.quote: he told me that in the middle of the river, and exactly opposite where we were camped, was a big rock in which the huge snake

claims.statement: The author had long heard of this snake; many local people and a few white men claimed to have seen it, and many more had seen its huge spoor in sand or mud.
claims.statement_id: Penulis sudah lama mendengar tentang ular ini; banyak penduduk setempat dan beberapa orang kulit putih mengaku melihatnya, dan lebih banyak lagi melihat jejaknya (spoor) di pasir atau lumpur.
claims.quote: We had long heard of this snake; many reputable Hottentots and a few white men claim to have seen it, many more have seen its huge spoor in the sand or mud

claims.statement: It is believed to take cattle from the riverbanks, and the local people fear it greatly.
claims.statement_id: Ia dipercaya menyambar ternak (cattle) dari tepi sungai, dan penduduk setempat sangat takut kepadanya.
claims.quote: It is believed to take cattle from the banks, and the natives fear it mightily.

claims.statement: The author exploded dynamite near the rock, but no snake appeared, only a few small fish.
claims.statement_id: Penulis meledakkan dinamit (dynamite) di dekat batu itu, tetapi tidak ada ular yang muncul, hanya beberapa ikan kecil.
claims.quote: The dynamite made a big upheaval, but no snake materialised; only a few small springers and barbel flapped round in the muddy water.

claims.statement: Local people are reluctant to guide expeditions to the spot because they believe the deep, black cavern is the Grootslang's home.
claims.statement_id: Penduduk setempat enggan memandu ekspedisi ke tempat itu karena percaya gua (cavern) yang dalam dan gelap itu adalah rumah Grootslang.
claims.quote: natives are reluctant to guide expeditions to the spot. They believe the deep, black cavern is the home of the

claims.statement: The cavern is said to connect with the sea forty miles away.
claims.statement_id: Konon gua itu terhubung dengan laut (sea) yang jauhnya empat puluh mil (forty miles).
claims.quote: The cavern, they say, is connected with the sea forty miles away.

claims.statement: The author dismisses local stories that the snake has huge diamonds in its eye-sockets and that all who see it feel a strange, evil influence.
claims.statement_id: Penulis menepis cerita setempat bahwa ular itu punya berlian besar di rongga matanya (eye-sockets) dan bahwa siapa pun yang melihatnya merasakan pengaruh jahat yang aneh.
claims.quote: Native stories that the snake has enormous diamonds in the eye-sockets, and that a strange and evil influence is felt by all who behold it, may be politely dismissed.

claims.statement: Eyewitnesses stated the snake was forty feet long, leaving a track about three feet wide on the muddy riverbanks.
claims.statement_id: Para saksi menyatakan ular itu panjangnya empat puluh kaki (forty feet) dan meninggalkan jejak selebar sekitar tiga kaki (three feet) di tepi sungai berlumpur.
claims.quote: White eye-witnesses state that the snake is forty feet long, leaving a track on the muddy river banks about three feet wide.

claims.statement: The author suggests that exceptionally large pythons have probably been seen in the river from time to time.
claims.statement_id: Penulis menduga yang sebenarnya terlihat adalah ular piton (pythons) yang luar biasa besar di sungai.
claims.quote: The truth probably is that exceptionally large pythons have been seen in the river from time to time

claims.statement: But in the local view there is only one Great Snake, greatly feared.
claims.statement_id: Namun dalam pandangan penduduk setempat hanya ada satu Ular Besar (Great Snake) yang sangat ditakuti.
claims.quote: But in the native mind there remains only one Great Snake, greatly feared.

claims.statement: Another reputed home of the snake and source of diamonds is the swirling pool below the King George Cataract at the Aughrabies Falls.
claims.statement_id: Tempat tinggal lain ular itu, yang juga dianggap sumber berlian, adalah kolam berpusar di bawah King George Cataract di Air Terjun Aughrabies.
claims.quote: and also a reputed source of diamonds, is the swirling pool below the King George Cataract at the Aughrabies Falls

claims.statement: The Great Snake's hoard is well guarded.
claims.statement_id: Harta timbunan Ular Besar itu terjaga dengan baik (well guarded).
claims.quote: The Great Snake's hoard is well guarded.

claims.statement: It is said to devour elephants (elefantes) by luring them into its cave (cueva).
claims.statement_id: Konon ia melahap gajah (elefantes) dengan memancingnya ke dalam guanya (cueva).
claims.quote: Se dice que devora elefantes atrayéndolos a su cueva

claims.statement: In this tale the gods (dioses), realising their mistake, split the Grootslang into separate creatures, creating the first elephants and snakes (elefantes, serpientes).
claims.statement_id: Menurut kisah ini, para dewa (dioses) menyadari kesalahannya lalu membelah Grootslang menjadi makhluk terpisah, sehingga tercipta gajah dan ular pertama (elefantes, serpientes).
claims.quote: Dándose cuenta su error, los dioses partieron al Grootslang en criaturas separadas y así se crearon los primeros elefantes y las primeras serpientes.

claims.statement: The lightning bird, also impundulu, thekwane, izulu or inyoni yezulu, is a creature in the folklore of the Zulu people.
claims.statement_id: Burung petir (lightning bird), juga disebut impundulu, thekwane, izulu, atau inyoni yezulu, adalah makhluk dalam cerita rakyat orang Zulu.
claims.quote: The lightning bird or impundulu or thekwane (or izulu, inyoni yezulu) is a creature in the folklore of the Zulu people.

claims.statement: The impundulu takes the form of a black and white bird the size of a person, said to summon thunder and lightning with its wings and talons.
claims.statement_id: Impundulu berwujud burung hitam putih seukuran manusia (the size of a person) yang dikatakan memanggil guruh dan petir dengan sayap dan cakarnya.
claims.quote: takes the form of a black and white bird, the size of a person, which is said to summon thunder and lightning with its wings and talons.

claims.statement: It is a vampiric creature associated with witchcraft, often the servant or familiar of a witch or witch doctor, which attacks the witch's enemies.
claims.statement_id: Ia makhluk mirip vampir (vampiric) yang dikaitkan dengan ilmu sihir, sering menjadi pelayan atau hewan peliharaan gaib (familiar) penyihir, dan menyerang musuh penyihir itu.
claims.quote: It is a vampiric creature associated with witchcraft, often the servant or familiar of a witch or witch doctor, which attacks the witch's enemies.

claims.statement: It is said to have an insatiable appetite for blood, and sometimes takes the form of a beautiful young man who seduces women.
claims.statement_id: Ia dikatakan selalu haus darah (blood), dan kadang menjelma pemuda tampan (beautiful young man) yang merayu perempuan.
claims.quote: It is said to have an insatiable appetite for blood. Sometimes it takes the form of a beautiful young man who seduces women.

claims.statement: Among certain tribes the hammerkop is believed to be the lightning bird.
claims.statement_id: Di sebagian suku, burung hammerkop dipercaya sebagai burung petir (lightning bird).
claims.quote: Among certain African tribes the hammerkop is believed to be the lightning bird.

claims.statement: The lightning bird is said to be immortal, because it outlives its masters.
claims.statement_id: Burung petir dikatakan abadi (immortal) karena hidup lebih lama daripada tuan-tuannya.
claims.quote: it is said that the lightning bird is immortal, because it outlives its masters.

claims.statement: Legend recounts that the bird is passed down in a witch's family from mother to daughter, doing the bidding of its owner.
claims.statement_id: Menurut legenda, burung itu diwariskan dalam keluarga penyihir dari ibu ke anak perempuan (mother to daughter) dan menjalankan perintah pemiliknya.
claims.quote: Legend recounts that the bird is passed down in a witch's family from mother to daughter, doing the bidding of its owner

claims.statement: The lightning bird is impervious to gunshots or stabbing and cannot be poisoned or drowned, but it is said it can be destroyed by fire.
claims.statement_id: Burung petir kebal terhadap tembakan dan tikaman, tidak dapat diracun atau ditenggelamkan, tetapi dikatakan dapat dimusnahkan dengan api (fire).
claims.quote: The lightning bird is impervious to gunshots or stabbing, it cannot be poisoned or drowned, but it is said that the creature can be destroyed by fire.

claims.statement: The bird is also believed to lay a large egg underground where the lightning strikes.
claims.statement_id: Burung itu juga dipercaya bertelur besar (large egg) di bawah tanah di tempat sambaran petir.
claims.quote: The bird is furthermore believed to lay a large egg underground at the location of the lightning strike.

claims.statement: It is considered an evil creature because it does the bidding of witches.
claims.statement_id: Ia dianggap makhluk jahat (evil creature) karena menjalankan perintah para penyihir (witches).
claims.quote: It is considered an evil creature because it does the bidding of witches.

claims.statement: The impundulu is a mythological creature (makhluk mitologi) in the folklore of peoples of southern Africa (Afrika bagian selatan), including the Pondo, Zulu and Xhosa.
claims.statement_id: Impundulu adalah makhluk mitologi dalam cerita rakyat suku-suku di Afrika bagian selatan, termasuk Pondo, Zulu, dan Xhosa.
claims.quote: makhluk mitologi dalam cerita rakyat suku-suku di Afrika bagian selatan, meliputi suku Pondo, Zulu dan Xhosa.

claims.statement: In Xhosa and Zulu mythology, an evil spirit which most often appears in the form of a bird; lightning bird.
claims.statement_id: Dalam mitologi Xhosa dan Zulu, impundulu adalah roh jahat (evil spirit) yang paling sering tampil sebagai burung; burung petir.
claims.quote: In Xhosa and Zulu mythology: an evil spirit which most often appears in the form of a bird; lightning bird.

claims.statement: People so attacked cough up blood and frequently die, so pulmonary tuberculosis is considered the work of the Impundulu.
